title: SCAddress MuxedContract{id, contractId} renders as a W address with the contract first
why: In XDR the 64-bit ID comes before the key in MuxedEd25519Account and MuxedContract, while the SEP-0023 strkey payload puts the key first; code that copies bytes between the two forms instead of converting field by field produces a valid-looking address for another key and ID.

known_divergences.detail: Executed on 16.4.1: the Protocol 30 XDR decodes the SCAddress, but Address.fromScAddress throws 'Unsupported address type: scAddressTypeMuxedContract'. Muxed contract addresses came to the Address class in 17.3.0 (#1811); the 16.x line does not have them.
